Damage_Scenario: Incorrect battery monitoring or contactor control leading to thermal runaway or loss of propulsion
Attack_Path: Software update interface (UDS flashing) or exposed JTAG/SWD debug port
Treatment: Reduce: Implement hardware-anchored Secure Boot; digital signature verification; and debug port lock

Damage_Scenario: Unauthorized configuration change; forced contactor actuation; or erasure of latched critical DTCs
Attack_Path: Vehicle OBD-II / gateway diagnostic CAN interface via unauthenticated UDS session
Treatment: Reduce: Enforce ISO 14229 UDS 0x29 certificate-based authentication; role-based access control; and session timeouts

Damage_Scenario: Incorrect battery state info or forged charging/HV enable requests causing overcharge or unintended HV activation
Attack_Path: Vehicle powertrain CAN / CAN-FD bus via physical tap or compromised neighboring ECU
Treatment: Reduce: Implement SecOC Message Authentication Codes (MAC) and monotonic freshness values on safety-critical frames

Damage_Scenario: Loss of firmware authenticity and communication integrity across the BMS trust anchor
Attack_Path: Direct Flash/EEPROM readout; side-channel analysis; or active debug interface
Treatment: Reduce: Store keys in isolated Hardware Security Module (HSM) with zero plaintext export and strict key lifecycle management

Damage_Scenario: Altered cell voltage/temperature thresholds allowing operation outside Safe Operating Area (SOA)
Attack_Path: Unauthorized UDS WriteDataByIdentifier (0x2E) or direct non-volatile memory manipulation
Treatment: Reduce: Protect calibration blocks with cryptographic signatures verified at startup and restrict write access to authenticated roles

Threat_Scenario: CAN bus Denial of Service / flooding (TS-006)
Damage_Scenario: Loss of BMS-VCU/OBC communication triggering emergency power derating and HV contactor opening during driving
Attack_Path: High-priority frame flooding on shared powertrain CAN bus from rogue node or compromised ECU
Treatment: Reduce: Enforce central gateway message filtering; CAN controller bus-off recovery; and deterministic safe-state fallback

Threat_Scenario: Malicious or downgraded software update package (TS-007)
Damage_Scenario: Fleet-wide compromise of BMS safety controls or re-introduction of patched vulnerabilities via rollback
Attack_Path: Man-in-the-Middle interception on OTA/service update path or replay of older signed binary
Treatment: Reduce: Enforce end-to-end asymmetric package signing; payload encryption; and hardware monotonic anti-rollback counters
